controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T08:53:14.500Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T09:53:14.500Z"
  AND host.name == "db-1"
  AND process.name == "sshd"
  AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS total = COUNT(*)
